cases.prompt: From a research question about a magnetized plasma shock, reconstruct literature, define the target observable, select the minimum adequate physics model, build a multi-fidelity execution graph, validate results independently, quantify uncertainty and record provenance.

For a pulsed plasma thruster/plasma-focus-derived problem, combine electrical/sheath observables, plasma scales, literature evidence, simulation hierarchy and validation without claiming causality that is not measured.
success_criteria: validation tied to I(t), sheath/plume observables

cases.prompt: After completing and validating a new cross-solver workflow, distill it into a draft skill that composes existing skills and includes unit, workflow, capability and negative cases.
